title: Order on approval
text:
39. Order on approval.—If the Court approves the proposal, the terms shall be embodied in an order

of the Court, and [] the order of adjudication shall be annulled, and the provisions of
section 37 shall apply, and the composition or scheme shall be binding on all the creditors [so far as
relates to any debt due to them from the debtor and provable under this Act].
